newsitem.title: USA: New York Times June, Q2 ad results mixed.
newsitem.headline: New York Times June, Q2 ad results mixed.

text.p: New York Times Co said Tuesday that June, second quarter and to year-to-date advertising volume for the New York Times and Boston Globe newspapers increased.
At its Regional Newspaper Group, advertising volume was down in June and for the second quarter but was up for the year to date, it said.
June advertising inches at the Times rose 4.7 percent to 300,200, while those for the Globe increased 4.1 percent to 232,900.
June volume at the Regional Newspaper Group was down 0.7 percent to 1,160,700 inches.
Second quarter volume at the Times was up 5.8 percent to 1,011,700 inches, and for the year to date rose 4.4 percent to 1,939,800 inches.
At the Globe, second quarter volume was up 3.8 percent to 770,500 inches, and year-to-date inches rose 4.3 percent to 1,478,700.
The Regional Newspaper Group's second quarter volume was down 0.01 percent to 3,988,800 inches, but year-to-date inches rose 0.05 percent to 7,733,100.
